title: Split Db into migrations layer and query facades
description: db.rs is 1,323 lines with 45+ public methods spanning four responsibilities: migrations, CRUD, graph queries, and convention persistence.\n\nExtract migration runner to db/migrations.rs. Group graph-oriented queries (import_edges, all_resolved_refs, all_symbol_file_map, batch_update_*_pagerank, update_rollups) behind a facade or into graph.rs. Move convention methods closer to FCA module.

acceptance_criteria.text: Graph-oriented queries owned by graph module or behind facade

messages.author: agent
messages.text: Split complete. db.rs (1334 lines, 45+ pub methods) → db/mod.rs (975 lines, 35 pub methods) + db/migrations.rs (205 lines) + db/graph.rs (72 lines) + db/conventions.rs (93 lines). All tests pass. No API changes — callers untouched.

edges.note: Db split should happen after FCA persistence is wired up
